_meta.prompt_text: Write a Python function named bank_rollback(balance, transactions) where transactions is an ordered number list of transaction amounts. Apply them in order in a single turn. If any transaction make the balance negative, just reject the entire list and return (balance, False) where balance is the original balance. Otherwise return (final_balance, True). (Ex. balance=100, transactions=[50, -30, -200] -> (100, False))
